features: Every image is a hand-authored SVG drawing
Elevations that draw themselves in on scroll
A real title block as the masthead
No photography, no stock, no templates
name: Atelier Voss
short: A studio site with no photographs at all.
long: The entire site is illustrated in hand-authored technical drawings: elevations that draw themselves in, hatched plans, dimension lines, poché section cuts. Cyanotype blue, and a real six-cell title block for a masthead.
proves: What a site looks like when nothing on it came from a stock library.
story: Proof that a site can be beautiful with nothing bought in: every line on it was drawn for it.
